concepts.name: human code
concepts.signature: prose from the user -> compiler input; stored as human_code in the map and projects.json

concepts.name: concept registry
concepts.signature: build/concepts.json: node pointers + concepts + decisions

concepts.name: causation map
concepts.signature: build/main.map.json: sentence @id -> owned character ranges

concepts.name: sentence node
concepts.signature: .human file: @id line + prose; keyed by the map

concepts.name: compiled code file
concepts.signature: build/<code_file>: the program the sentences cause

concepts.name: the compiler (claude)
concepts.signature: human code -> sentences + code + map + registry

concepts.name: instruction sheet
concepts.signature: CLAUDE.md: the spec that binds the compiler

concepts.name: program folder
concepts.signature: projects/<name>/: root sentence + children + build/

concepts.name: lowering
concepts.signature: parent sentence -> child sentences that add real meaning

concepts.name: file naming
concepts.signature: node file name = short word + 3-digit combination

concepts.name: projects registry
concepts.signature: projects.json: name + human_code per project

concepts.name: authoring tree
concepts.signature: folder tree: which sentence refines which, nothing else

concepts.name: node id
concepts.signature: stable 4-hex @id of a sentence

concepts.name: relation disagreement
concepts.signature: tree and map may diverge; divergence is information, not error

concepts.name: fragment
concepts.signature: map entry: owner-set + kind + character ranges

concepts.name: owner-set
concepts.signature: list of node ids that cause a fragment

concepts.name: joint causation
concepts.signature: several owners only together force a span

concepts.name: assumed fragment
concepts.signature: fragment of kind assumed: a why instead of prose

concepts.name: specified fragment
concepts.signature: fragment tracing to the user's words

concepts.name: no crossing
concepts.signature: any two ranges nest or are disjoint

concepts.name: full coverage
concepts.signature: every character under a node lies in a deeper fragment

concepts.name: no layer skipping
concepts.signature: a node's tightest containers form an antichain

concepts.name: containment
concepts.signature: range nesting: the poset that levels fall out of

concepts.name: reword
concepts.signature: wording change -> update .human + map text, nothing else

concepts.name: revise
concepts.signature: meaning change -> registry first, rewrite forced code, move moved ranges

concepts.name: recompile on concept change
concepts.signature: changed concept -> recompile every node that points to it

concepts.name: offsets
concepts.signature: LF-normalized character offsets, computed, snapped to boundaries

concepts.name: assert ground truth
concepts.signature: assert: lines are the only ground truth

concepts.name: note lines
concepts.signature: note: lines are never compiled and cause no range

concepts.name: web renderer
concepts.signature: web/: renders the emitted json, decides nothing

concepts.name: v1 lineage
concepts.signature: what bound the compiler in v1 still binds, in one list

concepts.name: concept id
concepts.signature: one kebab-case slug per concept

concepts.name: concept extraction
concepts.signature: node -> concept list (name, type, signature); rebuilt only on node change

concepts.name: candidate pairing
concepts.signature: near names | near embeddings | equal signatures -> pairs; different types removed

concepts.name: pair examination
concepts.signature: one pair -> ask for one differing example; example = different, none = same

concepts.name: difference example
concepts.signature: one case where the two concepts cause different results

concepts.name: decision record
concepts.signature: pair + same + example + tested, kept in the registry

concepts.name: ablation test
concepts.signature: change the concept, recompile; each connected node's code must move

concepts.name: no chaining
concepts.signature: a~b and b~c never make a~c; each new concept meets the whole group
